test_case.purpose: After an authoritative form-factor ruling, benchmark every device belonging to this row's approved target population with the four source fio profiles and compare per-device performance to the matching model/form-factor SPEC without touching other data.
required_package: Signed ruling: M.2 target population versus E1.S target population and relationship to row381
Corrected versioned Procedure/Criteria/Script mapping that retains this Source Key and Variant
Pinned fio/libaio and reviewed job manifest
Per-target model/serial/WWN/namespace/BDF/slot/stable-path map plus safe scratch policy and empty/backup proof

test_case.test_command: Do not run while form factor is unresolved and never execute literal `/dev/sdx`. After the owner issues the scope correction, bind only the ruled target population, double-verify each safe identity, then execute the exact 2 MiB sequential read/write and 4 KiB random read/write profiles one at a time with direct/libaio, depth16, jobs16 and approved runtime; retain all raw metrics and post-health evidence.
test_case.expected_result: For the owner-approved target population, every required device completes all four profiles and meets the matching model/form-factor numeric SPEC without identity drift, data loss, SMART/media/PCIe/thermal/power anomaly; no result from row381 or another form factor is substituted for this row.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS or executable testcase exists until the M.2-versus-E1.S scope and matching SPEC are signed. After correction, PASS is per target and profile with immutable identity, complete fio output, numeric thresholds and restored-health evidence; fio availability or row381 results are insufficient.
safety_gate: Gate closed until the target-form-factor ruling and versioned source correction exist
Exclude OS/boot/EFI/swap/mounted/LVM/RAID/device-mapper/unknown/data-bearing targets and require identity plus backup/empty proof
Authorize destructive writes and endurance impact separately for the ruled devices
Preserve logs; abort on identity, data, media, PCIe, thermal or power anomaly; no retry
expected_evidence: Owner-signed scope ruling and corrected M.2 or E1.S Procedure/Criteria mapping
Distinct Source Key/Variant and row381 non-substitution proof
Immutable device identities, exclusions, scratch/backup approval and job manifest
All four raw fio profiles, runtime/preconditioning and matching numeric SPEC comparisons
test_case.recovery: No destructive recovery can be finalized before the target population is known. After ruling, use only the form-factor/model-specific isolation and backup restore runbook; on wrong-target or health indication stop without retry, preserve evidence and quarantine the affected device.
